programs.description: Mohan, an IT employee, has a perennial snoring problem. Later, when he gets married, his issue strains his marital relationship.

Irshad and Haseeb, two teenage boys from Mattanchery, share a passion for pigeon flying, a local game. Later, Irshad opens up about a tragic incident that ruined many friendships in the neighbourhood.

When a powerful explosion occurs at the Vilayam beach seconds after Chief Minister Madhavan leaves the venue, Police Officer Rishikesh is tasked with the investigation to find the truth behind the blast.
Neil, a showroom executive, finds a bag full of money after a party. Later, he receives a call to meet at a secluded spot where he finds four strangers and gets involved in a dangerous deal.
Kalasadhan Ullas is an aspiring stage singer looking for his big break. However, his life is turned upside down when an opportunistic woman and her father target him for a nefarious purpose.
Chaos ensues after two reality show finalists compete against each other in a challenge in order to win a huge cash prize.
Lal Krishna, an eccentric criminal lawyer, defends the woman accused of Chinthamani's murder. However, he learns that there is more to the story and decides to dispense justice in his own way.
Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.
Kanan falls in love with Raddhu, the daughter of a ruthless city gangster responsible for numerous deaths. To marry her, Kanan must confront the dangers and challenges that lie ahead.
Nandha Gopalan Kumaran, a social worker, is forced to join politics to help his village. He faces various obstacles while learning the tricks to survive in power.

Vrinda, a rich young woman, falls in love with Vasu, a poor man. However, he rejects her advances due to his financial status.

Rajan, a policeman, goes after a powerful criminal but ends up losing his wife and is also left crippled. Soon, he becomes a jailer and recruits four vigilantes to trap the kingpin who ruined his life.
Agricultural officer Sachithanandan and his wife Shyama's life changes after the husband's womanising friend Jose visits for a few days.
After being misunderstood as a pervert in his village, Rajakumaran moves to Kochi to start life afresh. There, his life changes when he meets Manjari and Manjima.
The disastrous floods in Kerala in 2018 bring about fatal implications for every individual. Later, people from different backgrounds cooperate to weather the disaster.
When her spouse, Manu, gets kidnapped, Indu approaches her confidante Sagar for succour. Soon, Sagar goes to Goa to save Manu and gets entangled in a lethal game.
A seventy-year-old woman frustrated with her life, blames God for her misfortune. Subsequently, she magically transforms into a twenty-four-year-old after getting her photo taken at a studio.
Velayudhan, an orphan, is loved by the villagers as he keeps the village free from unsavoury people and practices. However, an evil moneylender and politician get jealous and try to get rid of him.
A young man suffering from a hearing defect rises up against a corrupt local leader along with the help of his fearless older brother. Together, they defy tyranny in a fight for justice and freedom.

Raghu, a responsible youth, faces the wrath of the villagers as he is the son of a lazy postman. However, Raghu's life takes a turn when he encounters Yasin Mubarak, a notorious man.
A newly married woman tries to become an ideal wife and daughter-in-law to her traditional and patriarchy family. Eventually, their growing demands and disrespect cause rifts between them.
Prabhakaran, a Gandhian panchayat member, fights corruption in Thonnurkara village. However, his crusade for people's welfare angers corrupt politicians.
Chandradas, a renowned poet, accidentally meets his estranged teenaged daughter, Harita. After coaxing her, he takes her to his ancestral home, but she starts missing her stepfather.
In the year 1983, the emotional fixation of a young man with his Maruti 800 car gets tested when he falls for his childhood confidante.
Sreehari has returned home from Paris after six years. He tries to settle some scores and clear misunderstandings with his old friends before leaving his village.
A man's first day on the job turns into a nightmare after some vengeful spirits begin to create trouble by trapping him in an elevator.
Joseph Alex and Bharathchandran, two police officers, try to prevent Major Abu Jalal Rana, a terrorist, from attacking New Delhi.

Black is Tharakan's servant who has an obsession for black clothes. His life changes when Meenakshi arrives at Tharakan's house and begins to unravel mysteries of his dark past.
United by tragedy, Mahmud and Inspector Jayachandran forge an alliance to dismantle a powerful crime syndicate, combining their quest for justice with personal vendettas.

In a charming island town, two young lovers, Govutty and Teena, find joy and resilience in each other as they navigate life's trials, discovering the strength that true companionship brings.
Gopalan, a notorious thief, teams up with Lakshmanan and continues to rob people. Their lives change when they kidnap a rich girl and find themselves trapped.
A group of masked fugitives kill the girlfriend of an international businessman, Casanovva. In order to avenge her death and capture the culprits, Casanovva sets up a fake television reality show.

Premachandran, a carpenter, rescues Kanmani, an ill-treated maid, and takes her into his care. However, to escape from her former abusers, Kanmani dresses up as a boy and joins the team of carpenters.
When V G Sadanand, the CM of Kerala, is poisoned on 15th August, the case goes to DSP Perumal. However, he soon realises that he is hunting a cunning criminal who leaves no evidence.

Mahadevan is a live witness of Radhika's hit-and-run accident. His helpful gesture of taking Radhika to the hospital, however, lands him in trouble when he is confronted by Meera, Radhika's friend.
Fed up with the fast-paced city life, Ramdas and his wife decide to move to a quiet bungalow on the outskirts of the city. However, some strange happenings in the surrounding put their lives at risk.
When two friends run into David, an IPS official, they reveal an unfortunate event that changed their lives. David helps them get out of the mess, but he is not what he claims to be.
An uneducated and noisy simpleton, Mike Philippose, arrives in a city as an organ donor for an old astrophysicist. Soon, he changes the lives of everyone around him.
An honest fresher faces chaos in his life by some boys as he joined college. After years of suffering, he finally decides to take on them.
Vinod, a quarrelsome young man, moves into his sister's house in a village to get his life in order. There, he happens to meet Anupama and falls in love with her.
A father and his son must reconcile their differences and face their past in order to defeat a late politician's privileged son, who is out to humiliate them.
When the daughter of a minister gets kidnapped, Christy is called upon to rescue her. Although he manages to save her, he himself gets embroiled in the kidnapper's murder.
Friends John, Kichu, Roopesh, Bava and Babumon decide to have a party on New Year's Eve. However, a series of events leads to a lot of unpleasantness and a rift between John and Kichu.

Kochu, an alcoholic, is a member of the Vadakkan Veettil family who leaves them after a fight. He later comes home for his share when their wealth is being divided.
Siddharth often has problems with his wife Anjali owing to his short temper. Things take an unexpected turn when they get involved with a gangster.
Inspired and captivated by Michael Jackson, a group of small-town boys strive to master breakdancing and mimic his iconic moves.
A girl from a wealthy family falls in love with a poor boy from her college. However, things take a turn when her disapproving mother sends thugs to kill her lover.
Ali Bhai, a goon, is the saviour of the poor in his dominion, Palayam market. However, when his enemies try to take over the market, he goes to great lengths to protect his stronghold and his people.
The lives of three happily married men are turned upside down by the arrival of a bar singer. They are later reunited during a holiday in Malaysia.
When a flight is hijacked by terrorists, Major Mahadevan and his team of commandos set out to punish the perpetrators and save the innocent hostages.
A renegade operative competes with the clock to prevent a nuclear disaster.
Notorious for his relationships with women, a single Kuttiyappan's life takes a turn when he sets out to fulfil one of his strange dreams.

Parthasarathy is well-loved by the people around him as he constantly works for their welfare. Soon, he falls in love with the daughter of his rival, unaware that she has an ulterior motive.
Agricultural officer Sachithanandan and his wife Shyama's life changes after the husband's womanising friend Jose visits for a few days.
Sam, a football player, gets admission in a prestigious international school under sports quota. His life changes for the better when he falls in love with a girl from the same school.
Sagunan always underestimates his wife and never appreciates her work. However, due to an unexpected turn of events, he ends up realising the value of not only his wife, but women in general.
Mathukutty, Zachariah and Binoy, whose fathers were friends twenty years ago, return to Goa in order to reclaim a casino. But they face many challenges when a local goon tries to plot against them.
Years after a young woman, Mythili, is murdered in a supposedly haunted mansion, Sethurama Iyer, a CBI officer, decides to find the culprit and solve the mystery.
A captain leads his team of soldiers inside a forest to investigate mysterious disappearances. However, they soon realise that the danger is more than they bargain for.
Struggling to pay for his mother's surgery, an unemployed lawyer resorts to illegal means to make money. However, as greed takes over, he goes to great lengths to become rich.
After he witnesses his entire family getting murdered over a video call, Surya decides to avenge their deaths. His fiancée, Gayathri, who is mourning the death of her brother, is ready to help him.

Kunchacko, a millionaire who built his fortune through questionable means, marries Mary and vows to change. However, leaving his past behind proves to be harder than he imagined.
In the small village of Thenkasimangalam, Chako and Gopi's families are cut-throat rivals. Owing to an unexpected turn of events, both the families actively start plotting against each other.
A man proposes to his close friend on the night before her wedding. However, he incurs the wrath of her older brothers when he elopes with her.
Vidyalakshmi struggles to lead a normal life with her daughter after the sudden death of her husband. However, her world transforms after meeting Preman, an auto-rickshaw driver.
When his father dies, Chandran is forced to go abroad to earn money to pay his father's dues. On a holiday to India, he meets his childhood lover and hopes to rekindle the relationship.
Thiruvambadi Thamban Tharakan, a businessman, strives to overcome multiple challenges and save his father from a dangerous man.
After serving 14 years in prison, a man is released on parole. As he tries to reconnect with his family, he vows revenge against those who wronged him.
Baba Kalyani, a police officer, travels to Kochi to uncover a terrorist conspiracy. He must not only work on the case but also deal with old rivals who are hell-bent on settling scores with him.
Thomas Kutty buys a haunted bungalow and convinces his friends to stay with him on the first night. The trouble begins when they actually see the ghost of the mistress who was killed 70 years ago.
